title: Curve properties after comparison base change
statement: Let k and K be fields, f : C -> Spec k a proper curve [def-weil-scheme-over-base, def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], b : D -> Spec K, p : D -> C a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism], and t : Spec K -> Spec k. If (p,b,f,t) is a cartesian square [def-pc-base-change], then b is a proper curve. No separable-closedness or algebraic-closedness assumption is required.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0A5E, proof: compatible algebraic closures, universal-homeomorphism vertical maps, and the bottom comparison arrow

proof.text: Apply MorphismProperty.of_isPullback to preserve properness. Its component properties supply separatedness, local finite type and quasi-compactness.

The universal homeomorphism p induces a homeomorphism of spaces. IsHomeomorph.topologicalKrullDim_eq transfers the dimension bound from C to D, including dimension bottom for the empty scheme. Combine with the inherited morphism properties.
